Seen • Just now
No worries — it’s pretty simple to start.
Put a little moisture on the tragus (the small bump in front of your ear canal).
Clip the earpiece to your left ear, with the cable going over and behind your ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light tingling sensation in your ear. 
Then just keep it on for 15–60 minutes per session while you read, work, meditate, or relax.
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually increase as it feels comfortable.
